doc.title: Peter Erskine interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 9, 2020

title: Closing quote about the power of a big band
summary: Rowe reads Erskine's quote on restraint in a big band, which he does not remember saying.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well said. I’m going to read a quote from you to wrap up.

Right along this line. “The whole thing about a big band is ultimately the power. The trick to releasing it is the discretion of when to do so, how much patience you want to have before you unleash that kinetic power. If it’s full tilt all the time nobody wins.”
